blocks.text: Earth had become a small blue circle behind him.
blocks.alt: Flaming Head crosses black space toward the growing Sun, with Earth a tiny blue point far behind.

blocks.text: Flaming Head watched it turn among the stars. Somewhere on that bright little world, Jenny would be moving the tape marks on the training-room floor. Seth would be helping her. Billy would have the radio turned up.
He faced the Sun again.
The light spread across his orange cheeks, but the flame above his brow remained low. He tried to raise it. The yellow tip stretched, trembled and settled back.
There was still a long way to go.
He crossed the darkness without a sound. The stars ahead faded as the Sun grew larger. Its bright edge curved away beyond his view, and the black spaces between him and it filled with gold.
Behind him, Earth dwindled to a blue point.
He kept that point in sight a little longer. Then he turned his eyes forward and held his course.
The first warmth reached him gently.
blocks.alt: A small, determined Flaming Head approaches towering folds of golden light at the Sun’s edge.

blocks.text: It touched the ends of his flame and ran along them toward his face. One small tongue of yellow lifted. This time it stayed up.
He moved closer.
What had looked smooth from far away broke into ridges and folds. Great loops of fire rose against the darkness, bent over and sank into the brightness below. Even the smallest were vast beside him.
He passed beneath one as it spread across his path.
His flame pulled sideways. He steadied himself, waited for the streaming light to thin, then continued through the gap.
The warmth deepened.
For the first time since the collector had drained him, he felt something other than the effort of keeping his little flame alight. There was energy here. More than he could measure.
He slowed at the edge of the glow.
Sunlight covered his face. His eyes narrowed, searching for a way through the moving gold.
Below him, a bright fold opened.
He turned toward it.
The darkness behind him narrowed to a strip.
blocks.alt: Flaming Head’s tiny flame-edged outline enters the Sun’s brilliant light.

blocks.text: He could no longer pick out Earth. Beyond the glare, somewhere among the fading stars, his friends were carrying on with their day.
He thought of Seth’s shaking hands beneath the beam. Jenny catching her breath beside the jack. His own small reflection in the facility window.
He had come to find enough power to help them.
The fold of light began to close.
Flaming Head moved forward.
Gold washed across his eyes. The edges of his flame blurred into the brightness around him until it was difficult to see where one ended and the other began.
For a moment, a small orange face was still visible against the Sun.
Then he went deeper.
The light closed behind him.
